description_en: Creates an IM channel for a specified agent and binds a publicly accessible ServiceEndpoint
description_zh: 为指定智能体创建 IM 渠道，并绑定可公开访问的 ServiceEndpoint
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore create-agent-im-channel --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAgentIMChannel

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to display the thinking process in IM messages. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示思考过程，默认值为 false
fields.name: show_thinking

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to display the tool calling process in IM messages. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示工具调用过程，默认值为 false
fields.name: show_tool_calls

fields.help_en:
The IM channel type. Valid values:

DINGTALK: DingTalk.
FEISHU: Lark.
WECOM: WeCom
fields.help_zh: IM 渠道类型。枚举值：DINGTALK（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECOM（企业微信）
fields.name: channel_type

fields.help_en: The channel credentials. All fields must be provided and field values must be non-empty strings. DingTalk uses clientID and clientSecret. Lark uses appId and appSecret. WeCom uses botId and secret
fields.help_zh: 渠道凭据，必须全量传入且字段值为非空字符串。钉钉使用 clientID 和 clientSecret，飞书使用 appId 和 appSecret，企业微信使用 botId 和 secret
fields.name: credential

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the IM channel. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否启用该 IM 渠道。创建时默认值为 true
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The ID of the ServiceEndpoint to bind. The endpoint must belong to the specified agent and its current version, be in the ready state, and have a public network address
fields.help_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint ID。该端点必须属于指定智能体及其当前版本，并已就绪且具有公网地址
fields.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: A reserved idempotency token. The backend does not provide persistent idempotency guarantees in the current phase
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等令牌，本期后端不提供持久化幂等保证
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The successful response for creating an agent IM channel
schema.description_zh: 创建智能体 IM 渠道的成功响应

code.description_en: The business status code. The value SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The IM channel information after creation
data.description_zh: 创建后的 IM 渠道信息

showThinking.description_en: Specifies whether to display the thinking process in IM messages. Default value: false
showThinking.description_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示思考过程，默认值为 false

showToolCalls.description_en: Specifies whether to display the tool calling process in IM messages. Default value: false
showToolCalls.description_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示工具调用过程，默认值为 false

channelType.description_en:
The IM channel type. Valid values:

DINGTALK: DingTalk.
FEISHU: Lark.
WECOM: WeCom
channelType.description_zh: IM 渠道类型。枚举值：DINGTALK（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECOM（企业微信）

createTime.description_en: The creation time in RFC 3339 format

credentialSummary.description_en: The channel credential summary. Only non-sensitive fields and configured secret field names are returned. Secret values are not returned
credentialSummary.description_zh: 渠道凭据摘要，仅返回非敏感字段和已配置的 Secret 字段名，不返回 Secret 值

configuredSecretFields.description_en: The list of configured secret field names. Secret values are not included
configuredSecretFields.description_zh: 已配置的 Secret 字段名列表，不包含 Secret 值

items.description_zh: 已配置的 Secret 字段名

nonSecretFields.description_en: The non-sensitive credential fields and their values
nonSecretFields.description_zh: 非敏感凭据字段及其值

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the IM channel. Default value: true
enabled.description_zh: 是否启用该 IM 渠道。创建时默认值为 true

endpointUrl.description_en: The public network access URL of the attached ServiceEndpoint
endpointUrl.description_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint 公网访问地址

serviceEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the ServiceEndpoint to bind. The endpoint must belong to the specified agent and its current version, be in the ready state, and have a public network address
serviceEndpointId.description_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint ID。该端点必须属于指定智能体及其当前版本，并已就绪且具有公网地址

status.description_en:
The IM channel status. Valid values:

CREATING: Being created.
READY: Ready.
UPDATING: Being updated.
FAILED: Failed.
DELETING: Being deleted.
DELETE_FAILED: Deletion failed
status.description_zh: IM 渠道状态。枚举值：CREATING（创建中）、READY（就绪）、UPDATING（更新中）、FAILED（失败）、DELETING（删除中）、DELETE_FAILED（删除失败）

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the current IM channel status
statusReason.description_zh: IM 渠道当前状态的原因说明

updateTime.description_en: The update time in RFC 3339 format

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 indicates success

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
